body: Separate from per-client Workers. Chosen: derive the in-flight count from running rows with a live lease plus a per-queue lock row to serialise claimers, so lease expiry frees a dead worker's slot; no counter table, no migration. Alternative: a counter table, which leaks slots on a crash. Hatchet and Redis refuse a non-zero Limit: Hatchet has only per-worker slots, Redis would need a lease-scored slot set.
title: Queue limit is cluster-wide (QueueConfig.Limit, CapQueueLimitGlobal)
